purpose: Frozen gameplay baseline for the MarsScape -> mixmash/mars port. This file and data.js are a preservation artifact: they pin the exact gameplay data the port must account for, so the parity ledger stays reproducible without needing the marsscape repository checked out.

target.note: Engine v4 is the ported engine: MarsScape gameplay rebuilt inside the server-authoritative command model.

rules: data.js is a verbatim copy. Never edit it to make the ledger pass.
Re-capturing the baseline requires bumping source.commit and the checksum in the same commit.
marsscape must not be archived, redirected, or marked legacy until the ledger reports 100% dispositioned and every disposition is Ported or an approved retirement.
